integrity.focal_source_date_evidence: Sun et al. SIAM Review DOI 10.1137/S0036144504443821 states Published online 2 November 2006; earlier public postings of this paper were not verified.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic symmetrization, exact spectral decomposition, Schur-complement minimization; reproducibility scripts supply finite consistency checks.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns continuous-time unnormalized Laplacian spectral gap, not stochastic-matrix second-largest eigenvalue modulus.
The graph must have equal three-edge internally disjoint routes plus one direct shortcut; edge costs are one per route edge and tau per shortcut.
Only the shortcut conductance is proved identical across all unrestricted optimizers; uniqueness of the full asymmetric allocation is not asserted.
Literature search is not an exhaustive proof of novelty; independent audit remains outstanding.
title: Sharp shortcut-cost threshold in spectral-gap-optimal three-edge parallel networks
